title: Meet ข ฉ ถ ฐ ผ
pedagogy: Letter shape, name, initial sound, and listening recognition; consonant class is reference information only. Practice the taught letters and review familiar spellings.

exercises.title: Sounds with a puff of air
body: Listen closely to the difference between k and kh, t and th, and p and ph.
The h in kh, th, and ph means a puff of air after the consonant. It is not a separate h sound.
Focus on recognizing each letter and its sound. The reference note about consonant class is for later tone lessons.

exercises.title: Compare the sounds
exercises.thaiExample: ข ฉ ถ ผ
body: Compare ข (kh) with ก (k), ถ (th) with ต (t), and ผ (ph) with ป (p).
Play each letter's audio and say its name aloud. Listen for the puff of air.
